rows.name: TACTO
rows.manufacturer: Meta AI (FAIR) — Wang, Lambeta, Chou, Calandra
rows.status: Open source (MIT). not a physical sensor: simulator of vision-based tactile sensors
rows.measured: Generates simulated RGB tactile images and depth maps (DIGIT, OmniTact and YAML-configurable sensors)
rows.sampling_rate: Hundreds of rendering fps (according to the paper)
rows.key_paper: Wang et al., "TACTO: A Fast, Flexible, and Open-source Simulator for High-Resolution Vision-based Tactile Sensors", IEEE RA-L 7(2):3930–3937, 2022 (arXiv 2012.08456)
rows.integrations: Sim-to-real research and reinforcement learning with DIGIT/OmniTact
rows.advantages: Free; fast; generates tactile data without hardware
rows.drawbacks: Sim-to-real gap; does not model physical forces in a calibrated way; not hardware
rows.notes: Confirmed: TACTO is Meta's simulator, not a sensor.
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending
